description: Clock-synced LFO with a shapeable wave, sent out at four points of the cycle at once.

params.text: Sets how many times faster than the clock the cycle runs, a whole number from 1 to 128.
Sets how much of the voltage at the MULTIPLY input is added to the multiply number, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 128.
Sets how many clock periods one cycle lasts, a whole number from 1 to 128.
Sets how much of the voltage at the DIVISION input is added to the division number, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 128.
Bends the wave towards a sine: at 0% the chosen shape is untouched, at 100% it is a sine.
Sets how much of the voltage at the SLOPE input bends the wave towards a sine, from full inverted to full.
Moves the sawtooth-triangle wave from a falling ramp at 0% through a triangle at 50% to a rising ramp at 100%; on the square wave it sets the share of the cycle spent high.
Sets how much of the voltage at the SKEW input changes the skew, from full inverted to full; 10V at full covers the whole range.
Shifts the start of the cycle, 0 to 360 degrees.
Sets how much of the voltage at the PHASE input shifts the cycle, from full inverted to full; 10V at full is a whole cycle.
Rounds the phase setting to the nearest quarter cycle, so 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees; the light is lit while that rounding is on.
Chooses the range of every output: -5V to 5V, or 0-10V.
Chooses the wave: a sawtooth-triangle whose slant SKEW sets, or a square whose high time SKEW sets.
Chooses what the cycle does while the outputs are frozen: keep advancing underneath, so the wave jumps on release, or pause and carry on from where it stopped.
Chooses how the HOLD input is read: each trigger turns the freeze on and off, or the freeze lasts only while that input is at 1V or more.
Chooses how the CLOCK input is read: as pulses whose spacing sets the period, or as a BPM voltage where 0V is 120 BPM and each volt doubles the tempo.

inputs.text: Sets the tempo everything else is multiplied and divided against; with nothing patched here the outputs do not move.
Voltage added to the multiply number through its attenuverter.
Voltage added to the division number through its attenuverter.
Voltage bending the wave towards a sine through its attenuverter.
Voltage changing the skew of the wave through its attenuverter.
Voltage shifting the start of the cycle through its attenuverter.
A trigger here restarts the cycle at the phase setting.
Freezes the outputs at their last value, either toggled by each trigger or held while this is at 1V or more, as the GATE and MOM. switch is set.

outputs.text: The wave at the clocked rate, -5V to 5V or 0-10V.
The wave an eighth of a cycle further on than the OUT jack.
The wave a quarter of a cycle further on than the OUT jack.
The wave half a cycle further on than the OUT jack.

notes: nothing moves until a clock is patched into CLOCK; read as pulses, two of them have to arrive before the period is known.

inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.7: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
